ops.title: PR #24 f1bf7be ubuntu tests time out in configure readiness fixtures
ops.premise: The f1bf7be fake sprite-env `services get` exits 0 for a missing service, so start_services skips the create and the readiness gate polls until its 30 s deadline in the success fixtures.

ops.text: CI run on f1bf7be: test (ubuntu-latest) failed; TestPluginsConfigureWritesSynckitStateBeforeServices/{fresh_host,existing_state_at_the_pinned_fingerprint} and TestPluginsConfigureAwaitsServiceReadiness/{every_socket_accepts,install_waits_for_the_last_socket} each failed at ~30 s (the readiness deadline); macOS passed because these tests are linux-only
